beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: What happens to a family cut off from Eden? Watch what God does in the very first chapter after the gate closes — because it destroys the picture of an abandoning God forever.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Adam and Eve built a life in the fallen world. And they prayed. And heaven answered. The veil kept them from His presence — but He never once went silent.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: And after many days an angel of the Lord appeared unto Adam, saying: Why dost thou offer sacrifices unto the Lord? And Adam said unto him: I know not, save the Lord commanded me.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Stop on that answer. I know not, save the Lord commanded me. Adam had been offering the firstlings of his flock for years without knowing why. Pure trust, ahead of understanding. And because he obeyed first, the explanation came:

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: This thing is a similitude of the sacrifice of the Only Begotten of the Father, which is full of grace and truth.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A similitude. Every lamb on every altar was a picture — pointing four thousand years forward, to the Lamb. Adam and Eve knew about Jesus Christ. The first family on earth had His gospel: faith, repentance, baptism, the Holy Ghost.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: Adam cried unto the Lord, and he was caught away by the Spirit of the Lord, and was carried down into the water, and was laid under the water, and was brought forth out of the water.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Baptized. The first man on this earth was baptized — same ordinance, same gospel, same Christ that saves anybody today. The gospel is not an invention of the meridian of time. It is older than the world.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And now watch the enemy's response, because it defines his playbook for the rest of history.

beats.speaker: devil
beats.text: I am also a son of God. Believe it not.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That is his first recorded sermon on earth. Notice what he did not say. He did not say there is no God. He said I am ALSO a son of God — a counterfeit claim to authority — and then: believe it not. Doubt, preached as doctrine. He has never fought religion. He manufactures his own.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: So from day one there have been two churches on this earth. The one God plants, with ordinances that point to Christ. And the imitation — wearing religious language, teaching men to believe nothing, and to love pleasure more than God.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Some of Adam's children listened to the angel. Some loved the counterfeit. And that split, right down the middle of the first family, is the war — running through every family since.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: But keep the headline. God did not wait one generation to preach Christ. The gospel came to Adam whole, immediate, and free. Nobody in the history of this world was ever born too early for Jesus.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: So when someone tells you the gospel started two thousand years ago — or that God leaves His children in the dark — tell them about the first altar. He taught the first family. He will certainly teach yours.

card.speaker: narrator
card.text: The gospel is older than the world. And nobody was born too early for Christ.
